register.labelZh: PISS 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: piss about 和 piss around 常用來強烈批評某人浪費時間或胡鬧。；piss somebody about 或 around 可以描述某人或公司不斷拖延、更改安排或製造麻煩,令別人受到折騰。；piss down 和 piss it down 是表示下着傾盆大雨的強烈粗俗說法。；piss somebody off 表示惹怒某人;兩字之間沒有某人時,piss off 則表示離開或滾開。
register.summaryEn: Piss about and piss around are common ways of strongly criticising someone who is wasting time or behaving foolishly. Piss somebody about or around describes situations in which a person or company repeatedly delays, confuses or inconveniences someone. Piss down and piss it down are strong, vulgar ways of saying that it is raining extremely heavily. Piss somebody off means annoy someone, while piss off without a person between the two words means leave or go away.
